lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines visible across the torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with increased density and shorter segments towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One topological bifurcation observed on the dorsal end of the tenth vertical line (counting from anterior), splitting into two distinct segments near the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Fragmented line segments identified on the anterior shoulder region and lower ventral flank, where white pigmentation terminates before reaching the mid-line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of three distinct white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch arranged in a non-linear grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white patch on the lower throat/ventral neck and a distinct singular white spot located immediately below the eye.
